brief.text: Pharmaceutical Preparations features twice in the cluster section, with CYBN and RLMD combining for more than $6.6 million across four buyers. GameStop Corp. (GME) generated the largest cluster total at $21,605,932 from three insiders, closely followed by UBER at $15,314,016 across two buyers, while ANGX and PNFP appear in both tables as multi-insider actions with notable individual filings. The single largest commitment overall belongs to Group 1 Automotive Inc. (GPI), where a 10% owner recorded a $23,669,114 purchase that surpassed every other individual transaction and cluster total.
